summary: Bench report now aggregates prompt/completion/total tokens across tasks and estimates USD cost using configurable per‑1M input/output pricing. Added a pure aggregation module with unit tests, wired config/env/bench CLI pricing, and recorded notes.
notes: Key changes: new aggregation module `src/bench/aggregate.rs`; added pricing fields to `LlmConfig` with env and bench CLI overrides; report includes `aggregate_usage` and `aggregate_cost`; notes recorded in `notes/2026-02-12-bench-004-aggregate-cost.md`.
